annotations.title: ROAD Act: screen a single-family purchase

description: Screen a single-family home purchase (a title order) under the ROAD Act ban on large institutional investors (350+ homes, alone or in concert; effective Jan 7 2027; Treasury NPRM TREAS-DO-2026-0529). Resolves the buyer through exact owner names on 17 county rolls, Texas franchise registry vehicles, mailing addresses and name roots to its control group; reads the property and seller from the roll; checks the exceptions records can speak to (36.11 purchase from another covered investor that held the home on July 11 2026, 36.5 build-to-rent, 36.9/36.10 lender and loss mitigation, 36.6 renovate-to-rent spend floor); returns decision (STOP_PROHIBITED_UNLESS_EXCEPTED, PROCEED_WITH_EXCEPTION_FILE, REVIEW, CLEAR_ON_RECORDS), penalty exposure, the control chain and a stored screening_id. Free.
